newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 18.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 18.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Friday even as hurricanes raged in the Pacific and Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Hurricane Danny, upgraded from tropical storm, was located about 450 miles (720 km) east-northeast of Matamoros, Tamaulipas state, moving northeast at three knots (4 miles/6 km per hour).
The hurricane was drawing rains to Veracruz state. Maximum winds were clocked from 15 to 20 knots (16 to 22 miles/29 to 38 km per hour), with waves from four to eleven feet high.
The Pacific's Hurricane Felicia reported at approximately 660 miles (1056 km) west-southwest of the Socorro island, and moving west-northwest at 10 knots (11 miles/19 km per hour).
Because of its distance and shift further west, Felicia was not expected to affect Mexico's coast.
Thunderstorms along the coast of Michoacan, Guerrero and Jalisco states and rains reported along most of the coastline.
